title: 4DMemory: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Memory with Harness-Augmented Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.32332v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humans efficiently process multimodal streams spanning hours to years, building persistent, fine-grained spatiotemporal memories that support reasoning about and predicting long-horizon events. In contrast, existing benchmarks focus on short- and medium-context tasks, and most foundation models struggle to preserve fine-grained information over long horizons. To evaluate and improve long-horizon spatiotemporal reasoning, we introduce the LongVideo dataset and the 4DMemoryBench. LongVideo comprises about 900 hours of video and over 5,000 manually reviewed questions covering visual, textual, and spatiotemporal reasoning across diverse context lengths. We further develop the 4DMemory Harness, which integrates four complementary skills, 22+ specialized tool models, and a model-specific retrieval-augmented generation system. translated_title: 4DMemory：基于工具增强智能体的长时程时空记忆基准测试
translated_abstract: 人类能够高效处理跨越数小时至数年的多模态数据流，构建持久、细粒度的时空记忆，以支持对长时程事件的推理与预测。相比之下，现有基准测试主要聚焦于短上下文和中等上下文任务，而大多数基础模型难以在长时程中保留细粒度信息。为了评估和改进长时程时空推理能力，我们提出了 LongVideo 数据集和 4DMemoryBench 基准。LongVideo 包含约 900 小时的视频和超过 5,000 个经人工审核的问题，涵盖不同上下文长度下的视觉、文本和时空推理。我们进一步开发了 4DMemory Harness，它集成了四种互补技能、22 个以上的专用工具模型以及针对特定模型的检索增强生成系统。通过对 13 个领先模型的评估，我们发现独立运行的基础模型在长时程任务上表现不佳，而 4DMemory Harness（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了包含约900小时视频和5000多个人工审核问题的 LongVideo 数据集及 4DMemoryBench 基准，并开发了集成四种互补技能、22个以上专用工具模型和检索增强生成系统的 4DMemory Harness，用于评估和提升基础模型的长时程时空记忆推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the LongVideo dataset (approximately 900 hours of video with over 5,000 human-reviewed questions) and the 4DMemoryBench, along with the 4DMemory Harness integrating four complementary skills, 22+ specialized tool models, and retrieval-augmented generation, to evaluate and enhance long-horizon spatiotemporal memory reasoning in foundation models.
